crosswalks.historical_boundary: Entire island of Tenerife, comprising all nine Guanche menceyatos and communal upland pasture
crosswalks.resolution_method: EU5 represents Tenerife as the single island location aguere. Its bounded calibrated area is 2,070.198395 km2 versus 2,034 km2 in the palaeodemographic study (1.78% high), so the complete historical island population maps one-to-one with no partial-coverage weight.
crosswalks.notes: This exact-island mapping includes every menceyato and communal pasture zone cited in the source. No city/hinterland inference, coastline clipping or inter-island aggregation is involved.
